title: Iterated Hom formula for the transition mate
statement: Let A,B,S be categories, E1:B to S left adjoint to e1, E2:A to S left adjoint to e2, and T:A to B left adjoint to R. Given a natural transition t:e2 to e1 followed by R, define sigma:T followed by E1 to E2 as its conjugate under E2 and the composite adjunction. For any f:E2 N to M, the E1-adjunct of sigma_N followed by f equals T applied to the E2-adjunct of f followed by the inverse scalar adjunct of t_M.

source.place: Tag 09T5: functor adjunction and its transpose

proof.text: Use the unit equation for conjugate natural transformations. Naturality of t moves f across t; the composite Hom equivalence is the composite of the two Hom equivalences. Apply scalar left-variable naturality and cancel its inverse Hom correspondence.

theorem compositeMate_homEquiv (a₁ : E₁ ⊣ e₁) (a₂ : E₂ ⊣ e₂) (b : T ⊣ R)
    (t : e₂ ⟶ e₁ ⋙ R) :
    ∀ N M (f : E₂.obj N ⟶ M),
      a₁.homEquiv (T.obj N) M ((compositeMate a₁ a₂ b t).app N ≫ f) =
        T.map (a₂.homEquiv N M f) ≫ (b.homEquiv (e₂.obj M) (e₁.obj M)).symm (t.app M)
